provider_degraded_429.historical_observation: Provider previously returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests in the Brain Chat UI at 127.0.0.1:8092. After funding the model account, synthesis improved.
provider_degraded_429.what_http_429_means: The upstream model provider rejected the request because the account is out of quota / rate-limited / unfunded. This is a provider-side limit, NOT a local service failure.
safe_recovery_steps: 1. Confirm local services are still up (status_brain_local.ps1 or manual /health on 8091 and 8092).
2. Do NOT restart local services unless they are actually down. 429 is provider-side.
3. Check provider dashboard / account quota and funding.
4. Wait and apply exponential backoff before retrying the chat prompt.
5. If a second configured provider exists, allow the runtime provider-selector to fail over (do not manually edit provider credentials).
6. Inspect the trace of the failing run (GET /v2/agent/runs/<run_id>/trace) to confirm 429 came from the provider and not a local guard.
7. If degradation persists, the runtime returns a deterministic_parity_finalizer fallback reply; this is safe (no writes). Continue read-only use until quota is restored.
